2607.22166.title: Learning Spatiotemporal Decision Priors for Efficient Path Planning under Partial Observability
2607.22166.paper_summary: Path planning under partial observability remains challenging because an agent must make long-horizon navigation decisions from only locally bounded observations. Nevertheless, historical trajectories contain reusable experience-guided directional preferences. Classical planners, however, typically solve each instance from scratch and lack an explicit mechanism to exploit such transferable decision knowledge, often leading to redundant node expansions and locally myopic search behaviors. Motivated by this limitation, this paper proposes ImiPath, a prior-guided learning framework that distills reusable spatiotemporal decision priors from demonstration trajectories and uses them as experience-informed directional guidance to bias planners toward reliable and promising search directions under partial observability. Specifically, ImiPath first constructs a local spatiotemporal observation representation, which encodes the spatial information of the local environment and the temporal information of historical trajectories. The SpatioTemporal-Attention Policy Network (STAPNet) then transforms this representation into dicision priors. These priors are further incorporated into heterogeneous planners as directional guidance, biasing the search toward locally promising regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ImiPath achieves competitive path quality and improves search efficiency by reducing redundant node expansions under local observability. Additional physical experiments on a magnetic microrobot platform further validate the adaptability and practical deployment potential of the proposed framework.
2607.22166.paper_summary_zh: 在部分可觀察性下的路徑規劃仍然具有挑戰性，因為代理必須僅根據局部的觀察做出長期導航決策。儘管如此，歷史軌跡包含可重用的經驗引導方向偏好。然而，傳統規劃者通常從頭開始解決每個實例，並缺乏明確的機制來利用這種可轉移的決策知識，這往往導致冗餘的節點擴展和局部短視的搜索行為。受到這一限制的啟發，本文提出了ImiPath，一種先驗引導的學習框架，從示範軌跡中提煉出可重用的時空決策先驗，並將其用作經驗引導的方向指導，以引導規劃者在部分可觀察性下朝向可靠和有前景的搜索方向。具體而言，ImiPath首先構建一個局部時空觀察表示，該表示編碼了局部環境的空間信息和歷史軌跡的時間信息。時空注意力策略網絡（STAPNet）然後將這一表示轉換為決策先驗。這些先驗進一步被納入異質規劃者作為方向指導，將搜索偏向於局部有前景的區域。大量實驗表明，ImiPath實現了具有競爭力的路徑質量，並通過減少局部可觀察性下的冗餘節點擴展來提高搜索效率。在一個磁性微機器人平台上的額外物理實驗進一步驗證了所提出框架的適應性和實際部署潛力。
